subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support a channel/session-scoped `/agent <name>` switch for configured agents, and what authorization policy decides which agents a channel sender can list or select?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses routing, channel command handling, session state, workspace isolation, tools, credentials, and sandbox policy, so automation should not choose the permanent security/product contract.

options.title: Design guarded session switch
options.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only authorized configured agents while preserving memory/workspace isolation and existing tool/sandbox policy.

options.title: Keep static routing plus focus
options.body: Decline direct configured-agent switching and keep bindings, `/focus`, `agents_list`, and `sessions_spawn` as the supported multi-agent paths.

options.title: Expose a plugin seam first
options.body: Design a generic command/agent-picker SDK seam so channel plugins can implement visible switching after the core policy contract exists.

recommendation.title: Design guarded session switch
recommendation.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only authorized configured agents while preserving memory/workspace isolation and existing tool/sandbox policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the routing and command files points to this handle, and the decision affects core multi-agent routing policy.
